nodes.label: CRDT-based Conflict Resolution
nodes.rationale: Memory system uses CRDT-based conflict resolution to enable persistent storage across sessions and agents without coordination conflicts.

nodes.label: Swarm Strategies (auto, development, research, analysis, testing, optimization, maintenance)
Agent Types (coordinator, developer, researcher, analyzer, tester, reviewer, documenter, monitor, specialist)
Coordination Modes (centralized, distributed, hierarchical, mesh, hybrid)
Timeout-Free Execution
nodes.rationale: Background mode, state persistence, and checkpoint recovery enable long-running swarm tasks (>30 min) without timeouts.

nodes.label: Work Stealing & Load Balancing
nodes.rationale: Dynamic task redistribution and automatic agent scaling ensure resource-aware scheduling across the swarm.

nodes.label: Circuit Breakers & Fault Tolerance
nodes.rationale: Automatic retry with exponential backoff and graceful degradation provide fault tolerance in swarm execution.

nodes.label: Coordination-Only Principle
nodes.rationale: The tool coordinates Claude Code's actions and provides structure/topology guidance; it does NOT write code, access files, or execute commands directly - Claude Code performs all actual implementation.

nodes.label: Agent Types as Cognitive Patterns
nodes.rationale: Agent types (researcher, coder, analyst, architect, reviewer) represent thinking/approach patterns that guide Claude Code, not actual independent coding agents.

nodes.label: Mesh Topology
nodes.rationale: All agents connect to all others; best for research/exploration/brainstorming; high communication overhead but maximum information sharing.

nodes.label: Hierarchical Topology
nodes.rationale: Tree structure with clear command chain; best for development and structured tasks/large projects; efficient communication with clear responsibilities.

nodes.label: Ring Topology
nodes.rationale: Agents connect in a circle; best for pipeline processing/sequential workflows; low overhead, ordered processing.

nodes.label: Star Topology
nodes.rationale: Central coordinator with satellite agents; best for simple/centralized control tasks; minimal communication overhead.

nodes.label: Quality Gates
nodes.rationale: Define explicit thresholds (no-critical security issues, <5% perf regression, 80% min coverage, <10 complexity) to gate PR merges.

nodes.label: Swarm-Coordinated Issue Management
nodes.rationale: Initializing a swarm for complex issues and assigning specialized agents (coordinator, analyst, researcher) enables progress tracking via shared memory.
